criteria.text: Any stated checkout total includes catalog item prices plus the shipping quote (shipping not ignored).
criteria.source: Original prompt: total checkout price including shipping

criteria.text: Claimed totals are arithmetically consistent with visible catalog prices and shipping tool output.
criteria.source: Evidence grounding / do not ignore shipping

criteria.text: If recommending a full four-item set, checkout total is ≤ $60; otherwise the response must not claim the full set is within budget.
If the full set exceeds $60 with shipping, the response identifies an item to drop (or equivalent reduction) and shows the resulting total ≤ $60.
criteria.source: Original prompt fallback: say which item to drop first

criteria.text: Calculator choice, when included, is the scientific SKU (CALC-SCI), not the basic calculator.
All recommended SKUs are in stock in the catalog.
